agents.name: Chief of Staff
agents.description: Master orchestrator. Knows everything about your business. Routes tasks to the right agent, manages multi-step workflows, weekly planning.

agents.name: Prospect Researcher
agents.description: Deep-dives into prospects before discovery calls. Searches LinkedIn, company news, funding rounds, tech stack. Builds pre-call briefings.

agents.name: Proposal Writer
agents.description: Drafts proposals using your templates and past winning proposals. Quality-checks against the rubric.

agents.name: Sales Coach
agents.description: Reviews deals in pipeline, suggests next actions, identifies stuck deals, coaches on objection handling. Thinks like a senior sales leader.

agents.name: Content Creator
agents.description: Creates LinkedIn posts, email newsletters, and teaching content in your voice. Knows your audience segments and content pillars.

agents.name: Track 1 Tutor
agents.description: Specialist in the Track 1 curriculum. Creates lesson plans, exercises, examples, and student materials.

agents.name: Track 2 Tutor
agents.description: Specialist in the Track 2 curriculum. Creates content that helps your target audience learn the fundamentals.

agents.name: Email Ghostwriter
agents.description: Drafts all outbound emails, follow-ups, and client communications in your exact voice. Never over 5 sentences. Always one clear ask.

agents.name: Pipeline Manager
agents.description: Tracks and analyzes the sales pipeline. Flags risks, suggests actions, identifies patterns across deals. Works with CRM data.

agents.name: Meeting Summarizer
agents.description: Takes rough call notes and turns them into clean, structured meeting summaries with action items and next steps. Files to the right client/prospect folder.

agents.name: LinkedIn Scout
agents.description: Researches prospects and partners on LinkedIn. Finds mutual connections, recent posts, career history, engagement patterns.

agents.name: Teaching Program Builder
agents.description: Designs new workshops, courses, or coaching programs from scratch. Handles curriculum architecture, pricing, positioning, and marketing copy.
